generator_cmd: python3 tests/data/script_fixtures/oa_gen.py $TMPDIR/oagen  (stdlib plan writer; touch -d + Info-ZIP zip; corpus zipped)
oracle_cmd: cd $TMPDIR/oagen/zipped && TZ=UTC; zipinfo -T ev.zip | awk '$NF ~ /\.plan$/{print $NF "\t" $(NF-1)}' | sort > t.tsv; for f in *.plan; do tr '|' '\n' < "$f" | awk -v f="$f" '{i=index($0,"="); print f "\t" substr($0,1,i-1) "\t" substr($0,i+1)}'; done | awk -F'\t' '$2=="stage"{print $1 "\t" $3}' | sort | join -t$'\t' - t.tsv | sort -t$'\t' -k2,2n | awk -F'\t' '{f[NR]=$1; t[NR]=$3} END{for(i=1;i<=NR;i++){ok=1; p=""; for(j=1;j<=NR;j++){if(j==i) continue; if(p!="" && t[j]<p) ok=0; p=t[j]} if(ok){c++; w=f[i]}} if(c==1) print w}'
